messages:
sophia: Quick heads-up — cutoff in ~4h for v0.21.0. Need to lock down: version bump, changelog merged, security ack, QA smoke + canary. I'll track here. Please call out blockers. TL;DR: no new schema migrations after cutoff unless emergency.

mike: taking the version bump. Are we bumping package.json + helm chart values? also which docker tag scheme — `v0.21.0` or `v0.21.0-rc1` for the canary?

ana: I'll handle the changelog. Draft PR at https://git.internal/r/redwood/changelog/pulls/3125 — entry is short: `v0.21.0 — routing + kv-cache bugfixes, perf regression fix, docs updates`. Will paste the snippet here after I push.

ben: QA: smoke run scheduled in 30m on staging. I'll do basic flows + latency checks on /generate and /embed. tagging @lucy to run the regression harness.

lucy: running regression now. FYI we saw a flaky RPS test earlier — rerunning with 60s warmup. Will post results.

carmen: security quick-check done: SCA + dependency review, no critical vulns. Left notes on the PR about a config var that changed. pinging @security-team for final ack. :eyes:

security-bot: Snyk scan completed for PR #3124 — 0 critical, 0 high, 2 medium (transitive deps). Full report: https://snyk.internal/report/abcd

mike: bumped and pushed tag `v0.21.0-rc1` to `release/v0.21` branch. PR #3124 created: https://git.internal/r/redwood/release/pulls/3124. Command used: `git tag -a v0.21.0-rc1 -m "rc1" && git push origin v0.21.0-rc1`

ana: pasted the changelog snippet into PR #3125:
```
## v0.21.0 (unreleased)
- Fix: KV cache warmup bug causing miss on short prompts
- Improve: routing policy fairness for mixed-latency models
- Docs: migration notes for model pinning and quantization flags
```

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: release/v0.21 -> us-west1, 10% traffic, start=1793445600 (in 40m). Monitor: latency, error-rate, CPU/GPU util.

lucy: smoke results: all checks passed except embed latency spike (p95 ~ 1.6s vs baseline 1.1s). Looks like batching config on canary is `max_batch_tokens=2048` vs staging 1024. @mike can you confirm if the new runtime default changed?

mike: ah yep, i flipped an experimental batching knob in k8s config earlier (`batching.default_max_tokens=2048`). Rolling that back on canary now, opened hotfix branch `hotfix/batch-default` and created PR #3126.

carmen: security note — runtime env var `REDWOOD_CACHE_MODE` changed to `aggressive` in release config. Sec team marked it low risk but requested an env audit. @ops can you run the env audit playbook?

ops: On it. I'll run the audit and post link in this thread when done. ETA 20m.

ana: docs check complete — added migration steps and example `config.yaml` snippet to docs PR #3127. 

mike: after rolling back batching and merging hotfix PR, I'll re-trigger canary.

lucy: rerunning smoke after hotfix merge; expect results in ~12m.

security-bot: Security team final ack: low risk, no blocking items. Log: https://sec.internal/audit/1793443200

sophia: Sweet — final checklist: version tag pushed (v0.21.0-rc1), changelog PR open, QA smoke in progress, security ack, docs PR ready. If smoke passes and nothing else pops up in next ~30m we cut the release and promote canary -> stable. Please add :thumbsup: when you confirm your item.

mike: :thumbsup: version/tag done, hotfix merged.

ana: :thumbsup: changelog + docs PRs up.

lucy: :thumbsup: smoke green now (latency back to baseline after rollback).

carmen: :thumbsup: sec ack recorded.

ops: :thumbsup: env audit posted: https://ops.internal/audit/1793443200

sophia: OK cutting release in ~10m unless objections. If you see anything strange, please raise here. Thanks everyone. :party:`
